authority: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
interpretation: This packet records first-party APEDA source observations for reviewer use. It does not approve the authority, opportunity, eligibility rule, benefit, window or publication status.
sourcePolicy: APEDA's BHARATI pages and terms control the operational record; the Startup India Playbook is discovery-only cross-check evidence.

records.sourceAnchor: About BHARATI; application process; programme announcements and official subpage links
observations: APEDA describes BHARATI as its flagship export-enablement initiative for India's agricultural and processed food export landscape.

The official eligibility page covers agri-food startups, export-enabling technology/service startups, SPS solution providers, exporters, FPCs and individual researchers/innovators/solo entrepreneurs for the SPS category.

The programme structure describes screening, a business challenge, a final cohort of up to 100 and a 120-hour acceleration programme. The official timelines page states Application Window Closed and says later phase dates will be intimated.

APEDA terms state that participation does not provide or guarantee direct funding, grants, investment or automatic access to other Government schemes. Optional one-to-one mentorship costs INR 5,000; common acceleration content is separate.
The record therefore remains a closed, review-gated accelerator opportunity. A future cohort, current form, category route, RCMC timing and amended terms must be reverified before actioning.
